blocks.text: The operation of any noise-creating blower or power fan or any internal combustion engine, the operation of which causes noise due to the explosion of operating gases or fluids, unless the noise from such blower or fan is muffled, is unlawful. (Code 1981 § 27-17. Code 1995 § 54-163.)
